name: Geshan
overview: Geshan was a male member of the tribe of Judah, known primarily as the son of Jahdai. His identity is briefly recorded in Scripture without additional narrative or descriptive details. This limited information situates him within the genealogical records of Judah.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Geshan' appears as a proper name in Scripture with no specific meaning or divine origin indicated. It is simply a personal name recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:47.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Geshan as the son of Jahdai. Beyond this father-son relationship, no further family connections are documented for him in the biblical record.
scriptureSignificance: Geshan's significance lies in his inclusion in the genealogical listings of the tribe of Judah, emphasizing the biblical focus on lineage and heritage. His mention as Jahdai's son contributes to the preservation of the tribe's genealogy, which is important for understanding the fulfillment of God's promises to Judah's descendants. Although not prominent in narrative events, his record underscores the faithfulness of God in maintaining the lineage of His chosen people.
